1.t: Woe to every (kind of) scandal-monger and-backbiter,

2.t: Who pileth up wealth and layeth it by,

3.t: Thinking that his wealth would make him last for ever!

4.t: By no means! He will be sure to be thrown into That which Breaks to Pieces,

5.t: And what will explain to thee That which Breaks to Pieces?

6.t: (It is) the Fire of (the Wrath of) Allah kindled (to a blaze),

7.t: The which doth mount (Right) to the Hearts:

8.t: It shall be made into a vault over them,
